about: THE PLACES WEAR THEIR OWN PIECE (COOK FIVE 11/17, VAMILY rules 453, 408, 409(c)). A real place (records/target/bb/real_places.json, by its id) drawn on its own block of the map by slices/bohemia_place_pieces.js, over the kit art of the kind it is like. bx/by = the block's ground centre in the picture, plate = the ground plate across in picture pixels (the game scales it to the block, times 'wide'), frames = the two beat frames. Made by tools/bohemia_cook5_the_places_wear_their_own_piece_11_17_26.py through the map's rig. A modder adds a place's id and its pictures here and it is drawn; a place with no entry wears its kind's kit art as before.
